rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned means
compound of mantra and varya indicating the foremost mantra
compound of ayuta and avadhi indicating a limit of ten thousand

items.question: What lifespan results from employing this foremost mantra?
premises: A specific foremost mantra is identified as the means.
The mantra produces an effect on life.
The resulting life reaches a limit of ten thousand.
items.inference: Employing this foremost mantra grants a lifespan extending up to ten thousand.
uncertainties: The unit of the ten-thousand limit is not explicitly specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: By this foremost mantra, life indeed extends up to ten thousand.
